title: just-deliver environment approval
description: The gate: an environment with this block accepts deploys only through `jd promote`. A set is promoted when it is qualified on `qualifiedOn` and `required` distinct listed approvers approved it. Literals, not expressions. Rules the schema cannot express: `qualifiedOn` is not this environment and `required` is at most the number of approvers.

qualifiedOn.description: The environment whose records must show the set qualified.

approvers.description: Entra object ids (lower case) that may approve.

separateFromDeployer.description: An approver may not be a principal that deployed the label on `qualifiedOn`. Required: a default would be a silent weakening.
